description: 10V 22uF X5R ±10% 1206 Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors MLCC - SMD/SMT ROHS
compatibility_notes: Second code on the existing generic 1206 22 uF capacitor: the plain generic ID keeps its reviewed preference C12891 (Samsung CL31A226KAHNNNE, 25 V X5R +/-10%). C1859 is the exact FH 10 V rated SKU (1206X226K100NT, X5R +/-10%), so it gets its own rated-variant ID (10_volt suffix) linked via generic_oomp_id, following the established rated-variant taxonomy (as with the C1592 16 V row). Rating comparison from the staged capture: same 22 uF value, package and X5R +/-10%, but 10 V is a lower rating than the 25 V preference - the variant must never silently replace the 25 V part in higher-voltage circuits; it exists so 10 V-class designs can pick the exact SKU explicitly. Two-terminal MLCC (pin_count 2); stock 76,002 recorded as observed. Edits made under the capacitor family lock.
